NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    target "maintenance_plus_300_to_500_kcal_for_breastfeeding"
  MACROS:
    protein "1.6 g/kg bodyweight (minimum 80 g/day)"
    carbohydrates "45..55% of calories (complex sources)"
    fats "25..35% of calories (unsaturated focus)"
    fiber "25..30 g/day"
  HYDRATION:
    fluids "2.7..3.5 L/day; add 500 ml around feeds and workouts"
    electrolytes "consider tablet if sweating; use iodized salt"
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    continue_prenatal "yes, per OB guidance"
    iron "18 mg/day if needed; pair with vitamin C"
    calcium "1000 mg/day"
    vitamin_D "600..2000 IU/day per labs/OB"
    choline "450..550 mg/day"
    iodine "150 mcg/day"
    omega_3 "DHA/EPA 300..500 mg/day"
  MEAL_STRUCTURE:
    meals_per_day "3 meals + 2 snacks"
    timing "protein snack within 60 min post-workout; small snack before late feed"
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    breakfast "oatmeal with milk, chia, berries, peanut butter"
    snack_1 "yogurt with fruit and granola"
    lunch "whole-grain wrap with chicken or beans, avocado, veggies"
    snack_2 "trail mix or hummus with carrots"
    dinner "salmon or tofu, quinoa, roasted vegetables, olive oil"
  NOTES:
    caffeine "limit to <=300 mg/day; time after feeds if baby sensitive"
    alcohol "avoid or allow single drink with 2..3 hours before next feed"
    allergens "monitor infant tolerance (dairy/soy) and adjust"
    weight_loss "defer aggressive cuts until >12 weeks; prioritize supply and recovery"
    constipation "fluids, fiber, prunes/kiwi; confirm supplements with OB"
    supplementation "clear new supplements with OB/IBCLC"
    admin "log hydration, meals, symptoms, and milk supply daily"

ADDENDA
  CORE_TIMELINE:
    weeks_1_to_4 "no direct abs; use diaphragmatic_breathing, pelvic_tilt, bird_dog, cat_cow"
    weeks_5_to_6 "add dead_bug and anti-movement if cleared; no doming/pain"
    weeks_7_to_8 "progress dead_bug/bird_dog volume; consider pallof_press if available"
    weeks_9_to_10 "introduce plank low volumes; monitor scar/symptoms"
    weeks_11_to_12 "progress plank and side_plank time; add light rotation control"
  HIIT_TIMELINE:
    weeks_1_to_4 "no HIIT (walk only)"
    weeks_5_to_6 "low-impact primer (not HIIT): steady walking"
    weeks_7_to_8 "intro intervals below HIIT: 6x1 min @ RPE 5, walk recoveries"
    weeks_9_to_10 "low-impact HIIT 1x/week @ RPE <=6"
    weeks_11_to_12 "moderate HIIT 1x/week (option 2nd if fully symptom-free)"
